info.title: LinkedIn API
info.description: NyxID-hosted LinkedIn profile, member text posting and managed company image publishing. Company images use a BYO Community Management app, original chat attachments, readiness checks and explicit per-post human approval. Readback requires separate read permission.

x-aevatar-tool.name: get_profile
x-aevatar-tool.description: Get the OpenID Connect profile for the connected LinkedIn member.

x-aevatar-tool.name: create_post
x-aevatar-tool.description: Create a text post on behalf of the connected LinkedIn member.

author.description: The author URN, for example urn:li:person:<id> from the connected profile subject.

specificContent.description: LinkedIn share content. For a text post, use com.linkedin.ugc.ShareContent with shareCommentary.text and shareMediaCategory set to NONE.

post.summary: Prepare, review and publish an image attachment to a LinkedIn company page in this chat

x-aevatar-tool.name: publish_image_attachment
x-aevatar-tool.description: Use in this same owner chat. preview uploads the original PNG/JPEG attachment and waits for organization-owned readiness. Show the returned page, full caption and original image. To edit, preview with draft_id and changed caption/image, invalidating old approval. publish with draft_id and exactly the same company, caption and attachment_id always asks the human, even Full access. cancel closes the draft. status needs only draft_id to report the saved outcome and check a known post receipt. Never retry publication after an unknown outcome. BYO organization permissions required; readback additionally needs r_organization_social.

company.description: Selected company organization URN; must match connection authority.

caption.description: Full literal visible caption; NyxID escapes LinkedIn little-text syntax.

attachment_id.description: Original PNG or JPEG in this conversation.

request_id.description: Required for preview: choose one UUID per deliberate draft revision; reuse it for retries, pending processing or lost responses. Edits use a new request_id and the prior draft_id. Never create a new revision to retry an unknown publication.

200.description: Ready preview, status, cancellation or replayed receipt

201.description: Post created, with verification status and any usable receipt

202.description: Image processing is pending and can resume

409.description: Draft conflict, proven not-sent refusal or ambiguous publication outcome

default.description: Concrete preparation or provider failure with stage and status
